0693f11e.text:
Charred Horns:

Much like the scorched spider fangs, the charred horns of the chimaera that reside in the Charred Vale, in the Stonetalon Mountains on Kalimdor, possess a much-prized quality.  

Pounded flat and properly treated, they become extremely resilient to physical stress.
0693f11e.title: Furen's Instructions

0ac51f24.text: The tremendous magical storms caused by the portals' converging energies began to tear the ravaged world apart. Ner'zhul, followed only by his most trusted servants, managed to escape through one of the portals as Khadgar fought desperately to return his comrades to Azeroth. Realizing that they would be trapped on the dying world, Khadgar and his companions selflessly decided to destroy the dark portal so that Azeroth would not be harmed by Draenor's violent destruction.
0ac51f24.title: Beyond the Dark Portal

103d8f42.text: Turalyon, Lothar's most trusted lieutenant, took up Lothar's bloodstained shield and rallied his grief-stricken brethren for a vicious counterattack. Under the ragged standards of both Lordaeron and Azeroth, Turalyon's troops slaughtered the bulk of Doomhammer's remaining forces in a glorious, but terrible rout.
103d8f42.title: Aftermath of the Second War

15bfb47d.text: Convinced that Ner'zhul was planning a new offensive against the Alliance, King Terenas of Lordaeron sent his armies into Draenor to end the orcish threat once and for all. Led by Khadgar and General Turalyon, the Alliance forces clashed with the orcs across the burning landscape. Even with the aid of the elven Ranger Alleria, the $r Kurdran and the veteran soldier Danath, Khadgar was unable to prevent Ner'zhul from opening his portals to other worlds.
15bfb47d.title: Beyond the Dark Portal

1cbf64a2.text:
Within just a few days of my visit I found myself tutoring the local children from the nearby farmlands.  The lessons went so well that the town mayor commissioned me to run a school and construction has begun on a brand new schoolhouse!  From Silverpine to Stormwind and now Moonbrook -- who would have guessed I would see so much of Azeroth!

Warm regards,

Stalvan Mistmantle
1cbf64a2.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Memories of Valor

2ff3c680.text: By all accounts, the heroes were successful in destroying the portal and saving Azeroth - but whether or not they escaped the death throes of Draenor remains to be seen.
2ff3c680.title: Beyond the Dark Portal

32b33362.text:
Missing: Corporal Keeshan

Last seen during the bloody battle at Stonewatch Keep, Corporal Keeshan was reported to have been dragged away by Blackrock Orcs.

It is believed that Corporal Keeshan is being held as a prisoner of war at the Blackrock encampment north of Lakeshire, just west of the pass leading to the Burning Steppes.

By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, anyone who aids in the recovery of Corporal Keeshan shall be rewarded by Marshal Marris.
32b33362.title: Missing: Corporal Keeshan

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Memories of Valor

37617c92.text:
King Llane I of the House of Wrynn

Liege Lord of Stormwind 

Defender of Azeroth
37617c92.title: King Llane I of the House of Wrynn

42d36bd4.text:
To the Honorable Headmaster Crillian,

My former Master, I write to you so that you might know what your apprentice has been doing of late.  Paying heed to your advice, I sought to build my knowledge and wisdom through travel outside the gates of our beloved Stormwind.  My journeys took me to many places but I have decided to take up residence here in the lovely town of Moonbrook.  The surrounding fields of Westfall are most beautiful as the harvest approaches.
42d36bd4.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

4801667f.text:
Dear Noble Sir,

Word of your need for a tutor for your children has traveled to me here in Goldshire, where I take up temporary residence in the Lion's Pride Inn.  Due to the unfortunate state of events in the region, I was forced to abandon my post as Headmaster of the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  Please accept my application to serve as tutor for your offspring.  Headmaster Crillian of the Academy can speak to you of my abilities if necessary.
4801667f.title: An Undelivered Letter

58eab1f7.text:
REPORT: Thieves

More alarming than the kobolds, a $r gang of thieves has emerged in the valley.  They wear red bandanas and call themselves a brotherhood.  This level of organization may lead to trouble, both here and in all of Elwynn Forest.

We have identified one of their leaders--one Garrick Padfoot--and hope to bring him to justice soon.
58eab1f7.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

645953b6.text: . . .downward spiral of despair.  First she mocks me and now she is engaged.  The ungracious charlatan was pretending to love when truly she desired to hurt me all along.  A black void lurks with in me now and it grows with each waking moment.  The blood I shall spill pales in comparison to the tears I have shed. . .
645953b6.title: A Bloodstained Journal Page

68dfe0b8.text:
There was nothing left for the ragged, scattered orc survivors but to flee to the last standing bastion of orcish power - the dark portal.

Turalyon and his warriors chased the remaining orcs through the festering Swamp of Sorrows and into the corrupted Blasted Lands where the dark portal stood. There, at the foot of the colossal portal, the broken horde and the rugged Alliance clashed in what would be the last, bloodiest battle of the Second War.
68dfe0b8.title: Aftermath of the Second War

7965fa2d.text:
COMMENDATION:

The bearer of these documents is to be awarded Deputy status with the Stormwind Army, having served Northshire with eagerness and distinction.  I am confident you will find this person useful in Elwynn Forest.

signed:
-Marshal Douglas McBride, 
Stormwind Army, Northshire
7965fa2d.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

7c0966e6.text: . . .most certain that she shares the same feelings for me now.  She even placed her hand on mine this morning.  When she smiles, her eyes light up like glittering diamonds.  Unspoken words pass between us.  I can feel her in my pounding heart and heated veins.
7c0966e6.title: Muddy Journal Pages

7cc90080.text:
Brother Neals,

My grapes are saved!  UNCLE, the bearer of this manifest, braved my thug-infested vineyard and gathered the grapes that I could not.  Although the Defias still roam across the river, nearly my entire crop has been salvaged.

You may add a full load of grape bushels to your stores.

May the Light protect us,
-Milly Osworth
7cc90080.title: Grape Manifest

80ccab01.text:
I shall travel to meet you in person when the winter rains subside and the roads are suitable for travel once again.

Until then,

Stalvan Mistmantle of Silverpine
80ccab01.title: An Undelivered Letter

8d54a2d9.text:
The Alliance armies led by Sir Anduin Lothar, Uther the Lightbringer, and Admiral Daelin Proudmoore pushed the orcs south into the shattered land of Azeroth - the first kingdom to fall before the orcs' ruthless onslaught.

The Alliance forces under Sir Lothar managed to push Doomhammer's clans out of Lordaeron and back into the orc-controlled lands of Azeroth. Lothar's forces surrounded the orcs' volcanic citadel of Blackrock Spire and laid siege to their defenses.
8d54a2d9.title: Aftermath of the Second War

90550c79.text:
Vial of Phlogiston:

The last stage of creating the armor will require an extremely hot forge.  To produce the needed level of heat I must have a vial of phlogiston.

The only known maker of this substance is the fabled Quilboar, Roogug, and he will not give it up without a fight.  Roogug dwells deep in Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens.
90550c79.title: Furen's Instructions

9186145a.text:
Living death on this page you will see.
Only will you find the key if you look beneath mindless undeath.
9186145a.title: Burnt Page

950a51a3.text:
Galvanized Horn:

The rare galvanized horn's toughness is the lynchpin of the entire piece of armor I will create, and so it too must be procured.

It may be gained from the rare chimaera matriarch in the Charred Vale.
950a51a3.title: Furen's Instructions

a877d8fc.text: Only a few months after Nethergarde's completion, the energies of the dark portal coalesced and opened up a new gateway to Draenor. The remaining orc clans, under the leadership of the elder shaman, Ner'zhul, charged forth into Azeroth once again. Intent on stealing a number of magical artifacts that would increase Ner'zhul's power, the orcs planned to open up new portals in Draenor that would allow them to escape their doomed red world forever.
a877d8fc.title: Beyond the Dark Portal

aec44f20.text:
REPORT: Wolves

There has been an increase in reported animal attacks in Northshire.  Eagan believes the  wolves in the valley were scared here from Duskwood.

Although the wolves rarely hunt $r prey, the sheer number of them has caused some incidents with farmers.  And many livestock have gone missing.
aec44f20.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Memories of Valor

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Memories of Valor

be4b2da4.text: . . .most strange and uncontrollable feeling.  Never have I felt the way I did today.  Whilst assisting Giles with his history lesson, Tilloa was outside tending to the flower garden.  After a few minutes she came inside and placed a scarlet begonia in my open palm and smiled at me in such a way that my heart felt as though it was trembling within my chest. . . .
be4b2da4.title: A Faded Journal Page

c29dd47f.text:
In the following pages, you'll find a list of the materials necessary to make fire-hardened armor.  Good luck, $c.


-Furen Longbeard
c29dd47f.title: Furen's Instructions

c30b8f6b.text: In a last-ditch effort, Doomhammer and his lieutenants staged a daring charge from the Spire and clashed with Lothar's paladins in the center of the Burning Steppes. Doomhammer and Lothar squared off in a titanic battle that left both mighty combatants battered and drained. Though Doomhammer narrowly succeeded in vanquishing Lothar, the great hero's death did not have the effect the warchief had hoped for.
c30b8f6b.title: Aftermath of the Second War

c562b99e.text:
REPORT: Kobolds

The activity of kobolds has increased in the vicinity of Northshire Valley.  They camp north of the abbey and within the Echo Ridge Mine in alarming numbers.  I have marshalled paladins, warriors and other local folk to aid me in ridding us of the vermin.

This progresses well.  And I will update as needed.
c562b99e.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Memories of Valor

e3b2c69f.text:
Scorched Spider Fangs:

The incendicite ore that is found in a cave near the vicinity of Thelgen Rock has scorched the spiders that dwell there.

The venom in their fangs boils and reacts with the fangs themselves to create a very tough substance.
e3b2c69f.title: Furen's Instructions

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Memories of Valor

ece052af.text: Outnumbered and driven mad by the curse of their bloodlust, the orcs inevitably fell before the wrath of the Alliance. Doomhammer was taken prisoner and escorted to Lordaeron while his broken clans were rounded up and hauled north - back to Lordaeron.
ece052af.title: Aftermath of the Second War

ee192a66.text:
The devastating Second War against the orcish horde left the Alliance of Lordaeron in a state of shock and disarray. The bloodthirsty orcs, led by the mighty warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, not only smashed their way through the $r-held lands of Khaz Modan, but had razed many of Lordaeron's central provinces as well. The unrelenting orcs even succeeded in ravaging the
elves' remote kingdom of Quel'Thalas before their rampage was finally stopped.
ee192a66.title: Aftermath of the Second War

f46f93ab.text: . . .anger and fury the likes of which I never knew existed!  How dare she.  As I was instructing Giles in the meaning of numbers, Tilloa appears before me with a suitor, holding hands in public nonetheless!  What an uncouth young man.  Rather than introduce me properly, Tilloa simply said, "Oh that's just my tutor, Uncle Stalvan.  He's a nice old man."  Old!  At that word my cheeks flushed with heat.  I am but a few years older and yet she betrays. . .
f46f93ab.title: Muddy Journal Pages

10276|2846a7fb.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2846a7fb.text: A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.

10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

10782|3ab7bddd.name: Royal Factor Bathrilor
10782|3ab7bddd.text:
Welcome to Stormwind!  I am one of the city's officers, aiding the citizenry of the city through our census bureau.  If you are in need of locating someone specific, then I might be able to assist you.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.

If you have business with me, then please proceed!

1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

11026|0161bb95.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|0161bb95.text: This kind of work isn't for the faint of heart. I have an uncle who lost a hand! Poor old Stumpy... anyway, if you're still interested I might be able to show you a few things.

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

1103|b31c2daa.name: Eldrin
1103|b31c2daa.text: I can tell that your wardrobe is in dire need of care.

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1257|fe52f4ea.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12657|6231de28.name: Don Pompa
12657|6231de28.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that night elf place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1299|fe52f4ea.name: Lisbeth Schneider
1299|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1314|23d8b931.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

15116|19dfe25a.name: Grinkle
15116|19dfe25a.text:
Hey Hey Hey!  I am here to promote a fabulous fishing tournament in Stranglethorn but you need to be tough enough to survive there and have enough skill in fishing to fish those waters.

 Come back later when you are more qualified!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1680|279d82d3.name: Matthew Hooper
1680|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

185403|7e1300bc.name: Cyriden Farseeker
185403|7e1300bc.text:
Elune-adore, traveler. I am Cyriden. My partner Relathor and I are working to unearth the lost artifacts of our people.

Much is remembered by the older kaldorei, but there is no telling what tales have been forgotten. Without our intervention, they will vanish from this world forever.

185404|1c902d7c.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404|1c902d7c.text: My partner and I are archaeologists, hoping to uncover the forgotten history of the kaldorei. It's hard work, but I feel an obligation to preserve the stories of those who came before me.

1901|08830bac.name: Kelstrum Stonebreaker
1901|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

1901|b02b9fad.name: Kelstrum Stonebreaker
1901|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2057|b0e063a7.name: Huldar
2057|b0e063a7.text:
This is a dangerous line of business!

Miran just left with a delivery. He should be back in a few minutes.

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

2367|279d82d3.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|466d697a.name: Daniel
247229|466d697a.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|58cf691f.name: Daniel
247229|58cf691f.text:
I am glad you asked!

Professions are skills pertaining to crafting, gathering, and general survival. There are many to choose from, with each offering their own unique benefits and economic opportunities. Whether you seek wealth, an opportunity to stock your guild's warehouse with useful items, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of wearing equipment crafted by your own hand, there's a profession for that.

Crafting recipes can be learned from trainers, such as those around here, and numerous other sources across Azeroth. Once learned, you can craft as many of that item as you wish, provided you can acquire the necessary materials.

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

247229|b3334d4d.name: Daniel
247229|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

247229|e9b56518.name: Daniel
247229|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

248415|a665cdb8.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings, $c. I can teach you skills and techniques.

253|e8768bd6.name: William Pestle
253|e8768bd6.text: Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

276316|2d041d67.name: Raul Sweete
276316|2d041d67.text:
Looking for adventure, are ye? Well, look no further!

This here dock serves the one an' only boat that'll take ye to the distant elven lands of Darkshore, and Menethil Harbor without even leaving yer stateroom! How's that for adventure?!

277|fe52f4ea.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

278|a87776c0.name: Sara Timberlain
278|a87776c0.text: Hello, good sir.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3136|77cd977b.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|77cd977b.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a $r that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

313|be6b48f2.name: Theocritus
313|be6b48f2.text:
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.

Do you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

341|f53a9fc6.name: Foreman Oslow
341|f53a9fc6.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, SINKWINE.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4258|92cfadea.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|92cfadea.text: I'm sorry lad but ye just don't have the foundation to learn what I have to teach. But don't fret, go speak with my student Rotgath, he'll help ye out.

4258|965533ff.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|965533ff.text: Welcome to the Great Forge lad. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5113|b02b9fad.name: Kelv Sternhammer
5113|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

514|783731be.name: Smith Argus
514|783731be.text: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a $R named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5150|33af2c00.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5514|211be282.name: Brooke Stonebraid
5514|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

9099|c91575ec.name: Sraaz
9099|c91575ec.text: Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.

913|2fd50a65.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|2fd50a65.text:
I can tell just by the way you're standing that you're no warrior.  

Why don't you go do something safe, like read a book.

914|08830bac.name: Ander Germaine
914|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

914|c3d2f0f0.name: Ander Germaine
914|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

161-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
161-progress.text: You say somethin', sonny?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
161-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

1698-accept.name: Kelv Sternhammer
1698-accept.text: Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the Alliance.  He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.
1698-accept.title: Yorus Barleybrew

1702-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1702-complete.text:
Ah, Barleybrew Scalder.  Great stuff!  So you've been to see Yorus, eh?

I can get you a shield, yes sir!  You won't find a better one, and that's no lying!
1702-complete.title: The Shieldsmith

1702-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1702-progress.text: Hello!  Dry times, don't you think?
1702-progress.title: The Shieldsmith

178-progress.name: Theocritus
178-progress.text: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say?  Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
178-progress.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

199-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

248-progress.name: Unknown
248-progress.text: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.
248-progress.title: Looking Further

249-progress.name: Theocritus
249-progress.text: Hurry, $N, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!
249-progress.title: Morganth

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

257-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-complete.text:
What? Success?

Take it from me, Sinkwineama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct. 

Well, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
257-complete.title: A Hunter's Boast

258-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-accept.text:
Sinkwineath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.

You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
258-accept.title: A Hunter's Challenge

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

274-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
274-progress.text: What is that you bring from Ashlan?
274-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

278-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
278-progress.text: Do you have the needed items?  Time is of the essence!!
278-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

280-progress.name: Unknown
280-progress.text: The top of the keg slowly twists off.
280-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.

54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92479-accept.name: Marshal McBride
92479-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479-accept.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.
92479-complete.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-progress.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479-progress.title: A Scribbled Letter

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

94-progress.name: Unknown
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye

94792-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94792-accept.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a $c.
94792-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94792-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94792-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94792-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94793-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94793-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young $c.
94793-accept.title: Training the Beast

94793-complete.name: Isaac Chan
94793-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94793-complete.title: Training the Beast

94863-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94863-accept.text:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a $c once more.
94863-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94864-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94864-progress.text: Go forth, $N, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
94864-progress.title: Taming the Beast

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
